source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The assigned configuration removes @stylistic/stylelint-plugin and its six explicit formatting rules. It retains stylelint-use-logical and csstools/use-logical:always, keeping the logical-property check separate from formatting. The author reports Prettier coverage, but static configuration inspection does not prove identical formatter results or diagnostics.
title: Stylelint drops stylistic formatting rules while retaining logical-property enforcement
